reports.title: Ovintiv Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial and Operating Results

guidance.heading: 2026 Guidance
section: The Company issued its fourth quarter 2026 guidance and maintained its full year guidance other than a modest increase to expected NGL volumes. The guidance assumes that an ongoing third-party midstream outage in the Montney persists for the full duration of the fourth quarter.

2026 Guidance | 4Q 2026 | Full Year 2026
Total Production (MBOE/d) | 615 – 640 | 630 – 645
Oil & Condensate (Mbbls/d) | 203 – 207 | 210 – 212
NGLs (C2 to C4) (Mbbls/d) | 78 – 82 | 85 – 87
Natural Gas (MMcf/d) | 2,000 – 2,100 | 2,025 – 2,075
Capital Investment ($ Millions) | $550 – $600 | $2,250 – $2,350
